_comment: Everything the pipeline assumes that is not read from the network. Each entry has a source.

published_claims.source: HSP-029 text (Context + Reproducibility sections), https://houseofstake.org/proposals/29 and https://gov.near.org/t/42644 ; measured there at block 216,701,043 on 2026-09-22

protocol_issuance_source: HSP-029 text, https://houseofstake.org/proposals/29 (cap 2.5% -> 1.6% target); parameter of the protocol, not measurable from RPC

published_figures._comment: Numbers other parties published, pinned with their source and the date we read them. compute.py compares them with the chain; it never fetches them.

revenue_dashboard.claim_text: NEAR captures a growing share of fees, feeding buybacks that permanently remove NEAR from circulation.

altcoinbuzz_2026_10_19.quote: The two figures do not match, and nothing published alongside them explains the difference.

held_not_burned_context.summary: SVRN CEO Sal Ternullo on the Bankless podcast: tokens bought with Intents fees are not destroyed but held in a 'permanent capital vehicle'.

hsp029_buyback_text.quote: Intents fee-switch buybacks, and any other revenue removed from circulation, stay removed.

published_figures.defillama_methodology_holders: Since 2026-02-23, NEAR's captured Intents revenue is used to buy back $NEAR on the open market (not burned), returning value to holders.

neardata_sample._comment: Stratified block sample over NEARData (one stratum per calendar month). NEARData sustained about 0.25 blocks/s from one IP in our probes (HTTP 429 after a burst of ~20), so 36 blocks x 10 months at one request per 3.8 s keeps a fresh pull under 30 minutes.
